headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a decisive victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jake Mangum leading the charge, going 4-for-5 with a home run and 3 RBIs. The New York Mets also secured a win, defeating the Kansas City Royals 7-3 behind Sean Manaea's 7.0 innings pitched. The Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Victor Bericoto of the San Francisco Giants, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. Other players on the injured list include Mick Abel of the Minnesota Twins, Zack Gelof of the Athletics, Mark Vientos of the New York Mets, Jake Irvin of the Washington Nationals, Matt McLain of the Cincinnati Reds, Tanner Banks of the Philadelphia Phillies, and Brad Lord of the Washington Nationals.

There have been several trades and roster movements, including the Minnesota Twins acquiring Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations. The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Matt Seelinger to the New York Mets for cash and RHP Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Pirates 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a decisive victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with a strong performance from their offense. Jake Mangum led the charge, going 4-for-5 with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings pitched. Tyrone Taylor led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Juan Soto's 21st home run of the season was a key play for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout Rays 12-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory. Ben Rice led the Yankees' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a close game to the Baltimore Orioles, losing 2-3. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Shutout Bid Falls Short in Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 0-0 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, handing the Brewers their loss.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Victor Bericoto on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants right fielder Victor Bericoto has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The injury occurred on July 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Twins Acquire Tommy Nance in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins have acquired right-handed pitcher Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Ryan Sprock and future considerations.
